claim: An interrupt breaks the recipient turn within 200ms.
method: Sent 50 interrupts against a live turn; measured time to turn abort.
result: p50 118ms, p95 187ms, max 203ms. One sample over budget.

claim: Queued messages preserve send order under load.
method: 50 concurrent sends from 4 agents; compared send and delivery order.

claim: A retired agent leaves its PTY attached.
method: Retired 3 agents; listed open PTY handles after each.
result: 3 of 3 handles remained open. Claim holds.

method: Drove all six Rooms with 7 live attention items; counted gold elements per frame.
